source.title: Larne Times, 10 January 1925, p. 1 ("The Urban Council Elections. The Results in Larne")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: The town clerk declared at the close of nominations that no nominations had been received other than the retiring members, who were re-elected for three years.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1925; all were re-elected unopposed (Larne Times, 10 January 1925, p. 1). Returned unopposed.
